title: LibScript Empirical Experiment Suite Manifest
description: Declarative specification for reproducible, multi-ISA empirical benchmark suites, SIGPLAN statistical policies, provenance envelopes, prerequisite gates, and LaTeX macro emission.

id.description: Unique lowercase identifier for the experiment suite (e.g., libtpu, edgcpp, libscript).

title.description: Human-readable title describing the empirical evaluation campaign.

protocol_version.description: Semantic version or conference protocol tag for the evaluation specification.

manuscript_dir.description: Relative or absolute path to the manuscript directory containing the target LaTeX source.

manuscript_tex.description: Primary LaTeX manuscript filename relative to manuscript_dir (e.g., libtpu_paper.tex).

target_repo_dir.description: Relative or absolute path to the subject source repository under empirical evaluation.

results_dir.description: Output directory where mechanical JSON benchmark artifacts are emitted.

generated_tex_path.description: Output path for generated single-source LaTeX metric macros and tables.

host_constraints.description: Host ISA, binary translation prohibition, and OS preparation constraints (RULE-2, RULE-3).

required_native_isas.description: List of native OS/ISA targets required across the evaluation campaign (e.g., linux_x64, macos_arm64).

forbid_binary_translation.description: Whether execution under Rosetta 2, QEMU user/TCG, binfmt_misc, or WoW64 emulation must fail hard.

prepare_host.description: Whether CPU performance governor locking, ASLR disablement, and swapoff are requested when privileged.

drop_caches_on_cold.description: Whether cold subprocess measurements drop kernel page caches (or use cold binary copy fallback).

cloud_sku_by_arch.description: Recommended bare-metal or dedicated-core cloud VM SKUs keyed by OS/ISA target.

^[a-z0-9_-]+$.description: Cloud instance SKU identifier for the target architecture.

trial_policy.description: Non-parametric trial, warmup, quantile, and PRNG seed policy (RULE-3, RULE-4).

warmup_runs.description: Number of unrecorded warmup runs executed prior to timed trials.

measured_trials.description: Number of recorded fresh trials captured into samples_ns.

quantiles.description: Non-parametric quantiles reported alongside min and max (e.g., [0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 0.99]).

items.description: Quantile fraction in the closed interval [0.0, 1.0].

dispersion_metric.description: Primary non-parametric dispersion estimator used for tables and PGFPlots error bars.

prng_seed.description: Deterministic PRNG seed shared across reference and target workload runs.

build_profile.description: Pinned release compiler and post-link stripping configuration (RULE-6).

cargo_profile_flags.description: Pinned Cargo release environment variables (opt-level, lto, codegen-units).

^[A-Z0-9_]+$.description: Pinned Cargo profile environment variable value.

c_compiler_flags.description: Pinned C11 benchmark harness compiler flags (e.g., ['-std=c11', '-O3']).

strip_mode.description: Deterministic post-link symbol stripping policy applied after recording unstripped sizes.

feature_variants.description: Named Cargo feature configurations built and measured (e.g., full vs. slim).

prereq_checks.description: Codebase prerequisite predicates that gate final benchmark locking (RULE-7).

items.description: Single prerequisite check gating one or more sub-suites.

id.description: Unique identifier for the prerequisite gate.

suites.description: Sub-suite identifiers gated by this check (e.g., ['E4', 'E6']).

kind.description: Verification predicate type evaluated against the target repository.

target.description: Relative file path or command inspected by the prerequisite gate.

pattern.description: Extended regular expression pattern matched for grep_present or grep_absent predicates.

description.description: Human-readable explanation of what codebase milestone this gate verifies.

subsuites.description: Ordered DAG of empirical evaluation sub-suites (e.g., E0 through E8).

items.description: Declarative definition of a single empirical sub-suite.

id.description: Short sub-suite identifier (e.g., E0, E1, E2, E3, E4, E5, E6, E7, E8).

title.description: Descriptive title of the sub-suite and manuscript targets.

depends_on_suites.description: Upstream sub-suite IDs that must complete before this sub-suite runs.

libscript_deps.description: Reusable Tier 1 LibScript components required by this sub-suite.

entrypoint.description: Relative POSIX/Batch script stem invoked to execute the sub-suite.

require_native_isa.description: Whether this sub-suite enforces native non-translated ISA execution (RULE-2).

outputs.description: Expected JSON or LaTeX output artifact paths relative to results_dir.
